Omni Partners Llp Boosted Its Nxp Semiconductors N V (NXPI) Stake by $256.88 Million as Valuation Rose; Wall Street Access Asset Management Has Raised Position in Apple Com (AAPL) by $1.31 Million
April 26, 2018 - By Marie Mckinney
Omni Partners Llp increased its stake in Nxp Semiconductors N V (NXPI) by 381.52% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Omni Partners Llp bought 2.20 million shares as the company’s stock rose 4.13% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund held 2.77 million shares of the semiconductors company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $324.47 million, up from 575,486 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Omni Partners Llp who had been investing in Nxp Semiconductors N V for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $34.95B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.42% or $1.46 during the last trading session, reaching $101.71. About 12.05 million shares traded or 138.02% up from the average. NXP Semiconductors N.V. (NASDAQ:NXPI) has risen 17.73% since April 26, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 6.18% the S&P500.
Wall Street Access Asset Management Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc Com (AAPL) by 52.07% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Wall Street Access Asset Management Llc bought 7,772 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The hedge fund held 22,697 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.84 million, up from 14,925 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Wall Street Access Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc Com for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $839.57B market cap company. The stock increased 1.11% or $1.82 during the last trading session, reaching $165.46. About 8.69 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since April 26, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Among 28 analysts covering NXP Semiconductors NV ( NASDAQ:NXPI ), 8 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 19 Hold. Therefore 29% are positive. NXP Semiconductors NV had 67 analyst reports since August 3, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The firm has “Hold” rating by SunTrust given on Wednesday, October 11. Drexel Hamilton maintained the stock with “Hold” rating in Thursday, February 8 report. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Tuesday, May 17 by CLSA. The stock of NXP Semiconductors N.V. (NASDAQ:NXPI) has “Neutral” rating given on Wednesday, December 21 by Citigroup. The stock has “Buy” rating by Topeka Capital Markets on Friday, February 5. Nomura initiated the stock with “Buy” rating in Monday, April 11 report. On Thursday, March 15 the stock rating was maintained by Deutsche Bank with “Hold”. On Monday, July 10 the stock rating was maintained by Jefferies with “Hold”. The rating was maintained by Robert W. Baird on Thursday, October 26 with “Hold”. SunTrust maintained it with “Buy” rating and $140 target in Tuesday, September 1 report.
Omni Partners Llp, which manages about $1.06B and $579.53 million US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Akorn Inc (NASDAQ:AKRX) by 43,564 shares to 343,008 shares, valued at $11.06 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing.
